identity.id: Existing immutable supplier UUID; continues as supplier_id in SAVE/RECORD
identity.code: Persisted nullable unique business identifier, initialized as NCC-001 and increasing for existing rows
identity.future_supplier_creation: Separate owner workflow; missing code is NOT_ASSIGNED, never synthesized by GET or client

additive_response_fields.display_name: code + ' - ' + raw name if assigned, otherwise raw name

search: q matches code OR name case-insensitively; percent, underscore and escape markers stay literal; status filter applies to both branches

app.picker_display: Use display_name; retain name separately as raw supplier name
app.write_identity: Unchanged supplier_id UUID and supplier_version only

migration.data_write_allowlist: Initialize only missing code; no other supplier field or table may change except the normal migration repository entry

release.source_and_live_acceptance: See exact candidate release evidence; this contract does not claim CI, migration or UI PASS
